landing.intro: **ventiws** is a WebSocket implementation for Node.js with the API of [ws](https://github.com/websockets/ws), delivered as a native addon whose framing engine is written in [Zig](https://ziglang.org). It targets `ws` 8.22.0 and reproduces that release's observable behaviour rather than its source. ventiws is not affiliated with the `ws` project and vendors none of its code.

wsApi.text: `WebSocket` and `WebSocketServer`, with option defaults matching `ws`: `maxPayload` 100 MiB, `maxFragments` 16384, and `closeTimeout` 30000 ms.

nativeAddon.text: the framing engine is Zig; the constructors are plain functions returning state records, with no `class`, no `this`, and no prototype.

noCompiler.text: per-platform binding packages mean `pnpm add ventiws` needs no toolchain.

compatibility.text: every `ws` surface item, its status, and the evidence test behind it are tracked in the repository's compatibility matrix.

devLogger.text: lifecycle records print as they happen (splash, open, close, error) with no callbacks to subscribe.

notes.warning: ventiws is pre-1.0: the surface may change between beta releases, and Windows is not supported yet. The compatibility matrix and the known divergences from `ws` live in the [repository](https://github.com/farbenbuilds/ventiws).
